errors.text_span: hellblau für Betriebe mit einem Mindestlohn von 10,45 bis unter 12 Euro und sehr hellblau für die übrigen Betriebe
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly names the color shades. The legend shows a dark blue, a medium blue, and a light blue. The description refers to the medium blue bar ('10,45 Euro bis unter 12 Euro') as 'hellblau' (light blue) and the light blue bar ('übrige Betriebe') as 'sehr hellblau' (very light blue), which is a misinterpretation of the visual shades shown in the legend.

errors.text_span: In der Kategorie „überwiegend negativ“ erreichen die dunkelblauen Balken etwa 52 %, die hellblauen etwa 43 % und die sehr hellblauen etwa 45 %.
errors.evidence: The relative lengths of the bars are described incorrectly. The medium blue bar ('hellblauen') is clearly longer than the light blue bar ('sehr hellblauen'), with values of approximately 48% and 42% respectively. The description reverses this relationship, stating the medium blue bar is shorter (43%) than the light blue bar (45%).

The categories on the y-axis ('überwiegend negativ', 'keine Auswirkungen', 'schwer zu sagen', etc.) are not sorted alphabetically. As correctly stated earlier in the same description, they are sorted in descending order based on the value of the 'unter 10,45 Euro' (dark blue) bars.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für die Gruppe „unter 10,45 Euro“ sind in allen Kategorien am längsten
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. In the category 'keine Auswirkungen', the dark blue bar ('unter 10,45 Euro') is the shortest of the three, with a value of approximately 25%, while the other two bars are at ~31% and ~42%.
